article.name: Free Plan: How to Convert/Recreate a Website With AI
article.title: Free Plan: How to Convert/Recreate a Website With AI
article.body:
AI Builder is a comprehensive tool that uses generative AI to automatically convert any web page to WordPress without copying the original code. You can recreate any webpage using only its URL. 

Note:

You can recreate as many pages as you like if you are a paid user or up to 10 pages for free users.

Get started for free

  1. Go to 10Web.io
  2. Click Get Started for Free
  3. In the What do you want to do? page, click Convert a non-WordPress site to WordPress with AI
  4. You can sign up with Google or fill in your information and click Sign Up
  5. Insert the URL of the page you want to convert with AI into the field
  6. Click Proceed to start a recreation
  7. Click Preview & Edit Your Website once recreation has been completed

To edit your website, please click try 10Web Pro for free for 7 days. Fill out the information to try the Pro version of the AI Builder for free for 7 days. If you want to convert/recreate more pages with the free plan, close the pop up to access the dashboard. 

Note:

The steps to convert/recreate a website are different for customers with paid plans. If you have a paid plan take a look at: Pro Plans: How to convert/recreate a website with AI
